//: Non-secret defaults. Secrets (Jwt:SigningKey, Smtp:Password, Bootstrap:AdminPassword) must come from user secrets in development and from environment variables or the IIS configuration editor in production. Never commit them here.

ConnectionStrings.//: Integrated Security uses the IIS application-pool identity, so no password exists anywhere. See database/05-security/01-database-roles.sql.

//awareness: The scheme's programme service. Enabled=false keeps the portal on the programmes an administrator maintains under Masters, which is also the fallback whenever the service cannot be reached. Token is a credential: user secrets in development, an environment variable or the IIS configuration editor in production — never this file.
//udyam: Udyam:Token is a credential. Leave it empty here and supply it via an environment variable or the IIS configuration editor.

FileStorage.//: Must sit outside the site root: uploads are streamed by an authorised controller action, never served directly by IIS.

Bootstrap.//: Set AdminEmail and AdminPassword once on a fresh install, start the API to create the Super Admin, then remove them.
